product_summary: Website anmolchem.com (Anmol Chemicals Group, est. 1976, Mumbai-based, plants in Western India) lists a very broad catalogue of pharmaceutical excipients, food-grade chemicals, some APIs and specialty/analytical reagents: benzyl benzoate BP/USP/JP/IP, benzyl alcohol, benzoic acid, methyl/ethyl/butyl paraben, gluconolactone, calcium gluconate, calcium lactate, lactic acid, citric acid, ferric ammonium citrate, adipic acid, fumaric acid, calcium stearate, glycerol monostearate, lauric acid, acetone, glacial acetic acid, benzalkonium chloride, diethanolamine, aluminium sulphate/chloride/chlorohydrate, calcium chloride, bismuth subcarbonate/subgallate/subnitrate/citrate, kaolin, borax, boric acid, glycerin, BHT/BHA, dextrose, carboxymethylcellulose sodium, croscarmellose sodium, hypromellose, cellulose acetate, acacia, guar gum, calamine, dimethicone, alfuzosin hydrochloride. Source: https://www.anmolchem.com/ (homepage product list).
role_hint: manufacturer_trader — site claims own FDA-approved cGMP/WHO-GMP plants plus 'toll manufacturing units' abroad and a very wide bought-in catalogue (analytical reagents, food-grade items, APIs), which is typical of a manufacturer that also trades. No customs line available to separate own production from resale.
comment: Declared codes 291632 (benzoic acid esters), 291719 (other acyclic polycarboxylic acids), 291816 (gluconic acid/salts) and 294000 (sugars/chemical sugars) are only partly consistent with the catalogue. 2916.32 is corroborated by benzyl benzoate and the parabens; 2918.16 is corroborated by gluconolactone and calcium gluconate. 2917.19 is plausible for adipic/fumaric-type acids but the site does not name a specific 2917.19 item, so it stays 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. 2940.00 (lactose/sugars) does not appear anywhere in the published product list — likely a mis-declaration or an unlisted traded item; marked 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. The declaration covers only a small slice of the real range: the bulk of the catalogue (inorganic salts 28xx, glycerol 2905.45, cellulose ethers 3912, gums 1301/1302, quaternary ammonium 2923.20, antioxidants 2909.60) is missing from the declared HS set. Industry label 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas and chemicals) is a misclassification: the company is pharma excipients / food-grade / specialty chemicals, no oil & gas line found. No customs line was available to this check, so every product mapping above is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' at the shipment level. Per rule 3 the HS mismatch is not a rejection ground — company retained, codes to be corrected to the actual excipient/inorganic range.
